review_scope: Bounded read-only inspection of V3 detail-cycle observer additions against actual final V4 source. Earlier browser base and manifest review is not repeated.

findings.evidence: main.js:5213 returns applyDetail(level);3119 returns inspectionSwitch.set; scene-loader.js:75-110 serial await prepare→atomic commit→true. main.js:5412 and5514 expose live detail and bankedAssets, not frozen snapshots.

scene-loader.js:51-70 explicitly maps Glessner Balanced/Light to sidecar.asset_lods.light, Full to sidecar.asset; actual sidecar default Full and Light paths exist. loadDetailAsset returns absolute key as assetUrl and requested level as assetDetail. main.js:1950 passes keepAssetBytes:false; normal fetchAsset is used again. Observer phase-bound requests compare exact absolute declared URL, independently require changed Balanced URL and original Full URL.

main.js:3030-3037 mutates original public record objects in stable loaded.registry and points replacement batch at them. Source sidecar is retained by spread copies. Observer directly checks registry, record and sidecar reference identity, in addition to SHA.

Observer hashes traversal-order node names, attribute key/count/itemSize/normalized/array type, index counts; material properties and texture slot/sampler/transform/dimensions/mip dimensions. UUIDs, GPU handles and freshly allocated Source/Texture identities are excluded. createBuildings preserves source materials by cloning (buildings.js:518-530). These are explicitly geometry METADATA checks, not a claim to full geometry payload comparison. Actual source bytes are pinned separately; held full-return GPU appearance is checked separately.

Requires actual api.detail balanced then full, bank0 at boot/away-return/cycle/reload, real Balanced and Full phase GLB requests, stable public identity, same Full URL, sidecar/mesh/geometry metadata/material-sampler SHA, same roll, exact camera position+quaternion. Real readPixels Full-return comparison is against pre-cycle returned frame and bounded by actual held baseline changed-pixel noise, no new tolerance or production weakening.

New cycle precedes existing actual WEBGL_lose_context then restoreContext path. It retains prevented actual loss, before-reload losses1/reloads0, post-reload sessionLosses1/reloads1 and load-event increment1; new Full bank0 assertion added. Normal boot-ready/compressed release/pending0/error checks remain.

Exactly four distinct allowed runtime paths with valid64hex SHA required. guard checks each actual tracked source and corresponding actual walk/ published file against supplied hash before and after; source/mirror/vendor/HEAD fingerprints must match. Four-path behavior unchanged by V3 diff.

limitations: Read-only review, not actual browser/lifecycle or memory PASS. No browser, native tests, source/app edit, workflow dispatch or CI mutation performed.
Current exact full source/published gates, actual both-profile memory and actual owned browser observer must close with honest results; historical checks do not qualify later changed source.
Geometry metadata fingerprint is intentionally not a complete mesh payload hash. Pixel tests are bounded same-camera diagnostics and do not establish general photo acceptance.
